NEW! T.O.X.I.C. Team-up
A brand new update brings two brand new members to the T.O.X.I.C. roster: Poizone’s robotic army, the Infected Infantry! And Lord Sludge’s molten magma monster form, the 
Megamortabeast!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24570646/cd9b9f0077e2d87ba8c96786b629bc6abc6bfdf4.png
NEW! Vault Jump Ability
Along with these hot new characters comes one cool new move, the Vault Jump! Give yourself an extra boost to reach those platforms that are just a *little* too far away. And if you’re bummed you can’t test out this new move with your favorite characters...well we’ve got some news for you!

NEW! Choice
We’ve decoupled abilities from their characters so you can now use any character you want with any ability: Sue Nami with Double Jump; Poizone with Boost; Hazard with Slide Jump - go ahead and mix it up!

You also might notice some slick new UI in the game designed to make your lava jumping experience all the more pleasant.

NEW! Items
Every character’s progression levels have been bumped up to 60 possible levels. So get in there and jump around to unlock some new stickers, action files, emotes, and new skins. As an added bonus we’re also giving everyone free Sea Stealth G.A.T. skins for this Spring update, just because we love you all so much.
 
If you can’t get enough of all things G.A.T., there are all new G.A.T. lore descriptions for Head, Back, and Trinket accessories. Read through them all to learn about the exploits of all your favorite characters.

NEW! Leaderboards
You asked. We listened. Leaderboards are now split up by ability so you can save separate times and replays for each one. Unfortunately (or fortunately depending on your times) we had to reset leaderboards to accomplish this. Fear not, your locally saved replays are still available in their original directory, but your times pulled from Steam will be reset. 

As a bonus feature we’ve also added the ability to change your profile. Free yourself from the tyranny of sharing times with your little sister! Or, if you just want to experience the thrill of unlocking all your items again, now is the perfect time to jump in and get moving. Let the competition begin!

Stay safe. Stay cool. And stay off the floor!

T.O.X.I.C. has invaded Hot Lava SDK! Lord Sludge and Poizone's new moves are now available to add to community maps. Explore new challenges with the double jump or slide jump movesets.

New LavaEmitter
A simmering new lava generator automatically makes better looking - and sounding! - lava. Just enable the excellent new LavaEmitter to fill your your homemade map's lava with vfx and sfx.

Improvements and Bug Fixes
We’ve also added lots of fixes and modkit usability improvements, including some great advancements in the Randomizer gamemode. We’ve ironed out a bunch of issues and added more Inspector info to make it easier to use Randomizer to create daily challenges generated from fragments of your existing courses!

notes.title: Jen Forcer's Tactical Training Updates (Roadmap - 2021)
notes.content:
Originally posted by DanaS on the official forums:

It has been just over a year since Hot Lava launched on Steam and Apple Arcade and we wanted to check in with our amazing fans to say thanks and update everyone about some of the exciting things we have planned for the future.

Previously on… Hot Lava

Our fantastic fan base was instrumental and inspirational in aiding the team to polish Hot Lava through the thrilling beta phase of development. Their heroic feedback pushed the boundaries of what this game could be and epically cheered us on as we equipped Hot Lava with bigger and better challenges. We cannot stress enough how crucial our fans were in this truly transformative time.

Along with our monumental release, a thrilling new audience appeared thanks to Apple Arcade! This new audience showed us that people were just as enthusiastic about jumping around in molten hot environments on mobile as on PC. 

Over the past year we’ve been pummeled with a lot of positive feedback and some sensational suggestions about how to make Hot Lava more accessible to newer players and to seasoned pros.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24570646/23b52cc3b5934c190b5d5548d58329aa6dddcba6.jpg

And now...

Our newest update introduced two T.O.X.I.C. new characters -- Lord Sludge and Poizone -- armed with two new movesets. Poizone’s double jump gives players a way to leap to some hard to reach spots and Lord Sludge’s slide moves provide an alternative to hitting those higher speeds previously only achievable by mastering our boost system.

Teaming up with these new characters is our amazing new progression system that introduced a whole new set of rewards: sensational new skins and character-specific items that are unlocked when players level-up their character and awesome new Action Files to fill you in on lots of G.A.T. and T.O.X.I.C. trivia.

Apple Arcade users with LiDAR-equipped devices also got an added treat in Hot Lava’s incredible new AR feature. Finally, people at home can enjoy the fun of having molten hot lava fill their living room without all the messy clean up.

We’ve gotten some great feedback on these new features, including suggestions on what you want to see. So, on that note, we’d like to let you in on what we have planned for Hot Lava: Year 2.

Next Time on Hot Lava...
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24570646/cd5ef0fa1f064d3f4f3b25207463b3ded71fb61f.jpg
Jen Forcer’s Tactical Training Updates

Our mission moving forward is to make the game more accessible to newer players while still challenging veteran players with four phases of fantastic updates we’re calling ‘Jen Forcer’s Tactical Training Updates’ periodically deploying throughout the coming year. Updates that fall under a few categories:

Menu and Early Course Overhaul
We’re on a mission to improve our user experience. It’s our duty to leave no Hot Lava player behind, whether they’re hardcore veteran players or rookies who just jumped in. With this in mind we’ll be shining up and shipping out improvements to our menu system. Things like making it more apparent where your items and unlockables are and implementing a replay saving system that will bring videos of your runs front and center so they’re easier to locate.

Some of our early courses will also see some improvements throughout the year to make it easier for first time players, yet still challenging to those who want to push themselves to be the best that they can be.

New Characters
Lord Sludge and Poizone were just the first in a slew of new characters we plan to unleash. While our lips are sealed on which characters are coming up and when, rest assured that some long rumored appearances from figures outside of the GAT universe have set their sights on future invasions.  

New (non-Canon) Levels
A brand new level made by one of our collaborators will arrive this winter, and with it will be some exciting new exclusive items to unlock. We also have an arsenal of community maps from our awesome modding community which we will deploy for future fun.

New Items, New Skins, New Content
Keep a lookout for new content including items and skins and videos for everyone to enjoy. We’re hard at work making new content for the game and calculating ways to improve what we have.

As always we want you to send us feedback. So sign into the forums and let us know how we’re doing. We always read what you post and always look forward to dispatches from the field.

Stay cool, stay safe and stay off the ground.

notes.title: Hot Lava officially Launching Today!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=TNXoTLn5ISs;full][/previewyoutube]

It’s happening! 

We’re incredibly happy (and proud) to say after many long years of development that Hot Lava is being officially released today. It has been an incredible journey to get to this point, and it’s something we couldn’t have done without your support.  

During the beta, the Hot Lava community helped us release 27 updates, and we are planning to continue to update and improve the game with everyone else who is joining us today. We saw an incredibly talented mapping community emerge, creating some awe-inspiring custom content. We also saw a speed running scene grow that is unlike anything we could have ever expected. The Hot Lava community has been so important to this game during development that we can’t help but thank you again.

It’s amazing to look back at how far we have come from the first version of Hot Lava. You are going to be playing a series of new worlds, Playground, Wholesale and Mastery that were added during the Beta, as well as a brand new world called “Basement” launching today. Our item system has moved away from randomized drops and towards a purely progression based unlock system. Mechanics have been refined over numerous iterations to create an incredibly deep player controller. We have also added full controller support, optimized performance and translated the game into 15 languages. But we still have so many exciting updates we can’t wait to share with you.

So with all that, we hope to see you all jumping on furniture very soon. And whatever you do… don’t touch the floor.

Development Update
Some time ago Hot Lava closed sales to new players, and we began work on responding to the issues we saw in the game. We are working incredibly hard to finish Hot Lava and your continued feedback is a huge part of this. We are addressing issues in the new player experience, daily challenges, content fatigue, and enriching the Hot Lava world with more detailed and interactable environments. I wanted to take a moment to reassure everyone that we are working on tons of new and exciting content for future updates.  

Coming soon: Playground: Bouncy Land course
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24570646/e54366543eaf309ccfe1085e929bc6156cc9f53b.png

We have also been hard at work on a new wave of characters with unique locomotion mechanics. These mechanics share similarities with the base character, but change some aspect to allow you to re-experience the game with a unique twist. They will also allow us to explore other fun movement mechanics missing from the base game, building on the foundation we have created with our GAT 'boosting' characters. 

Tons of other content is in the works, and we will release more information as things solidify. Thank you for being here with us -- I can't wait to show you what we are up to next!

Community Content Bounty Program
I've been totally blown away by the content our community has produced for Hot Lava since our Closed Beta launched. Today I'm pleased to announce that we are starting a "Bounty" program to help reward outstanding community content. 
Content that is selected for the bounty program will be embedded directly in the game for launch, the creators will be listed in the credits, and financial compensation will be provided. 
I'll be discussing the details and constraints more over the following weeks on our official Hot Lava discord channel. If you are interested in joining in, stop by and say hi!

notes.title: This Phase of Beta Ending Today
notes.content:
Tomorrow we are ending the current phase of beta and with that we will be closing sales for the game until the next phase is ready. We have received tons of invaluable feedback from the community that has had an immeasurable impact on the game. Our path forward is now clear and we need to take some time to make the changes required to make sure we deliver the best experience possible. 

Development of Hot Lava will continue to operate as it has been and no significant changes to the development of the game have been made.
Those that have already purchased will continue to own Hot Lava and be able to play throughout development, as well as the final game when it releases
We will still provide periodic updates, allowing you to test the latest features and content
Updates will have a general focus on overall structural and systematic changes, and will be less focused on player retention and marketing
Sales will resume when we are ready to expand to a larger audience
We still absolutely welcome your continued feedback and suggestions

I want to once again thank everyone for all the love and support you have shown over the open beta phase, and I can’t wait to show you what we are working on next!

-Mark

notes.content:

Hazard modeling the new football item set

As we are working hard on preparing Hot Lava for Early Access, I wanted to take some time to talk about some amazing things going on in the Hot Lava community.

Translations
Yesterday we added support for user created translations of Hot Lava, and in under 24 hours we have seen 'Russian', 'Spanish', 'Turkish' and even 'Pirate' translation mods appear on the workshop! If you are interested in helping translate Hot Lava to another language, details can be found on the Klei forums.  To view translations as they are added visit the workshop

Custom Levels
Through the Community Spotlight we have been highlighting some of the best and most accessible levels the community has been producing.  But please know this is just the tip of the iceberg- the workshop is littered with plenty of other creative, surprising, and challenging maps!
View workshop maps

Modkit Update
The Modkit is being updated today.  Support for multi-course levels,  game modes (like pogo), consistent export names (only retire leaderboard when you intend to), modkit friendly wall jumps and much more!  It's strongly recommended that you install the modkit to a new project and port existing maps over to avoid corruption. We will continue to build on and improve the Modkit based on your feedback.  The new modkit should go live in the next hour.

Community Tournament
The speed running community for Hot Lava has become very competitive.  Many world records have been secured by fractions of a second.  A "Full School Run" tournament will be happening on the 22nd at 11am PST, 2pm EST,  7pm CET.  The competition will be streamed on Twitch.  If you think you have what it takes and want to sign up,  or are just interested in following the competitive scene an event discord has been setup.

Award Items 
To show our appreciation towards the community we have added two award items.  The Wrench and Crown.  These items will be awarded for recipients of the Community Spotlight and the to the winners of select Community Competitions respectively.  Those who were featured in previous spotlights have retroactively received this award. Thank you for helping grow Hot Lava through your contributions!
https://i.imgur.com/f5xBPvk.gif

Developer Stream
Klei hosts a weekly developer stream where we talk about on of our games- and this week (like, right now) you can catch us talking about Hot Lava.  More details are available on the Klei forums.

Hot Lava Discord
If you are interested in becoming involved in any part of the Hot Lava community- or just want a chill place to hang out, please join me on the Hot Lava Discord.
